import sys, os, io
sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
for k in ['OPENROUTER_API_KEY', 'PLACE_MODEL']: os.environ.pop(k, None)
from unittest.mock import Mock, patch
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas
sys.path.insert(0, '/root/worktrees/send-c1b/backend')
from dealroom_sign import placement
from dealroom_sign.tests import placement_r24_review_cases as R24
from dealroom_sign.tests.test_placement import TWO
rc = R24.rc; X = 72
print(rc.RECITALS['parsed'][:1])
FLEET = [(240, 'FLEET TEST CO.', False, X), (270, 'By:', True, X), (300, 'Date:', True, X)]
AFF = [(520, 'HARBOR LIGHT GROUP, INC.', False, X), (560, 'By:', True, X), (600, 'Date:', True, X)]
pat = dict(name='Pat Smith', email=rc.PE)
def mixed(fill_own, fill_all=False):
    out = io.BytesIO(); c = canvas.Canvas(out, pagesize=(612, 792)); c.setFont('Helvetica', 10)
    for row in rc.RECITALS['parsed']:
        c.drawString(row[3], 792 - row[0] - 8, row[1])
    c.showPage(); c.setFont('Helvetica', 10)
    def rule(x0, y, x1, fill):
        if fill: c.rect(x0, 792 - y - 0.4, x1 - x0, 0.75, stroke=0, fill=1)
        else: c.line(x0, 792 - y, x1, 792 - y)
    for y, text, isrule, x in FLEET + AFF + [(340, 'HARBOR LIGHT ANALYTICS, INC.', False, X)]:
        c.drawString(x, 792 - y + (2 if isrule else -8), text)
        if isrule: rule(x + 10 + c.stringWidth(text, 'Helvetica', 10), y, x + 218, fill_all)
    c.drawString(X, 792 - 370 + 2, 'By:'); rule(X + 28, 370, X + 218, fill_own or fill_all)
    c.drawString(X, 792 - 382 - 8, 'Name: Pat Smith'); c.drawString(X, 792 - 394 - 8, 'Title: CEO')
    c.showPage(); c.save(); return out.getvalue()
with patch('httpx.Client.send', Mock(side_effect=AssertionError('http'))):
    for label, b, ppl in [('own stroked', mixed(False), [pat]), ('own filled rect', mixed(True), [pat]),
                          ('own filled rect, both', mixed(True), [TWO[1], pat]), ('all filled rects', mixed(True, True), [pat])]:
        r = placement.place(b, ppl, model_client=Mock())
        print(label, '|', r['status'], r['reason_code'], [(f['signer'][:3], f['type'], f['evidence']['line'], f['confidence']) for f in r['fields']])
